title: One route or many?
hook: Two drawings show feeding relationships at different scales.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy habitat, grass feeds a rabbit and a mouse, and both can feed an owl. Which drawing represents the feeding web rather than one chain?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: In a toy habitat, grass feeds a rabbit and a mouse, and both can feed an owl. Which drawing represents the feeding web rather than one chain?

claims.text: In a toy habitat, grass feeds a rabbit and a mouse, and both can feed an owl. Which drawing represents the feeding web rather than one chain? A chain follows one route; the web includes both stipulated feeding routes. Arrows show food going to its consumer, not an animal moving along a path.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A diagram shows algae feeding two grazers, both eaten by one fish. Is that one chain or a web of routes? Two branches connect to the fish, so the drawing has multiple linked feeding routes.
